snippet.title: Direlands: Extraction — Early Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Direlands: Extraction is a spellcasting extraction RPG inspired by games of old. You delve into the zones of the Direlands — the drifting fragments of a world that was shattered long ago — in search of the runes its guardians have hoarded ever since. Access is only temporary: the rift becomes unstable and closes. Find what gear, gold and scrolls you can, then get out before it does — or lose it all.

🔷 Wishlist on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4726670/
🔷 Join the Discord → https://discord.gg/zsf3Kmr9bH

This is early gameplay captured from a work-in-progress build. Everything here is subject to change.

GAME OVERVIEW
Step through the rift and into a zone full of secrets. Explore solo or with up to three friends collecting gear, scrolls, XP, and gold to help your character progress — but the rift is unstable and will not wait for you. Find an extraction rune and use it to open your way home. It won't be easy — you will need to battle hordes of enemies to clear the way out — just don't be there when the rift closes!

CHAPTERS
0:00 Intro
0:12 Entering a zone
0:25 Solo or 4-player co-op
0:38 Spells, telegraphs and tells
0:52 Surviving the swarm
1:03 The rift is collapsing
1:13 Wishlist on Steam

Made in Unity by Milk Barf Games.
